description: This file implements an example IPC server and client using socket pairs, with a custom service that echoes a string in uppercase. It includes server setup, service implementation, client spawning, and event processing.

classes.name: MyExampleService
classes.description: A custom implementation of the ExampleService that performs an echo operation converting text to uppercase.

methods.name: exampleEcho
methods.description: Handles an RPC call to echo a string in uppercase and respond.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when the RPC call completes.

methods.name: childProcessMain
methods.description: Main function executed in the child process to perform an IPC call.

methods.name: spawnClient
methods.description: Creates a new process to run the childProcessMain with the given socket.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when a client disconnects from the server.
